study type: Theoretical review with a retrospective cohort example
cohort: Women who delivered at the Magee-Womens Hospital, Pittsburgh, PA, in 2003-2010
finding: A non-inferiority trial approach identified weight gain ranges associated with no meaningful increase in adverse perinatal outcomes:  -0.97 to +0.33 SDs (11.3-18.4 kg) for normal-weight women and -2.11 to +0.29 SDs (4.4-18.1 kg) for overweight women.
